heading: Authorizations of appropriations

tree.heading: Recipients and purposes of funds
tree.text: There are authorized to be appropriated to the President to carry out the purposes of this part—

children.text: $2,015,000,000 for the fiscal year 1986 and $2,015,000,000 for the fiscal year 1987 for the following countries signing the Camp David agreement: Israel and Egypt; and
$1,785,000,000 for the fiscal year 1986 and $1,785,000,000 for the fiscal year 1987 for assistance under this part for recipients or purposes other than the countries referred to in paragraph (1).

tree.heading: Availability of amounts
tree.text: Amounts appropriated to carry out this part are authorized to remain available until expended.
